bench_e2e.title: End-to-end SQL bioseq.load + mmsearch vs minimap2 (2/4 Gbp dna4/dna5)
bench_e2e.description: Exact one-row clean-restart lifecycle proof. The row must execute all-SIMD against PostgreSQL-owned MPF Format-5 ABI3 data, read one 160-byte manifest per session, and use no fallback.

test_case_descriptions.E2E_FORMAT5_SIMD_LIFECYCLE_SMOKE: One-repeat 20-Mbp clean-restart smoke for the production all-SIMD Format-5 MPF reader
